name: Safety Sensors — Kestrel
html:
Creating a safer way to get around is core to our mission. Every part of Kestrel is designed to earn your trust.

Sensors that see it all

The Kestrel robotaxi combines cameras, radar, and long-wave infrared sensors for a full 360-degree view of everything on the road. It never gets tired or distracted, and it can anticipate and react to its surroundings faster than any human driver.

name: AI Tech — Kestrel
html:
Kestrel combines the state of the art in perception, prediction, planning, and collision avoidance to get you there safely and comfortably. Every time.

AI-driven mapping

Equipped with an array of sensors and powered by AI, our test vehicles build live 3D maps of every city we operate in. Kestrel vehicles keep these maps current and use them to navigate every ride seamlessly.

Learn how Kestrel navigates >

name: Manufacturing — Vantor Aviation
html:
Process & Capabilities

Vantor is a vertically-integrated company, meaning we design, engineer, test and manufacture our critical aircraft components in-house.

  • 4.1

    Performance Engineering

    We deliver best-in-class performance through ultra-lightweight, highly optimized design. From airframes to actuators, every component is engineered in-house with a relentless focus on efficiency.

  • 4.2

    Equipment-level testing

    We run equipment-level testing at scale, with dedicated labs that support the full range of development and certification work, enabling rapid iteration across every system.

  • 4.3

    Precision and quality

    Our manufacturing process is built for scale without compromising precision, made possible through a close partnership with Meridian Industrial's advanced production systems.

  • 4.4

    An American company

    Designed, engineered, built and tested in the United States.
